statement: [방법론 실패 규칙] KR quality_profitability single-signal long-only는 구조적 실패. (1) GP as single-factor(Novy-Marx 2013, Piotroski/Ohlson 결합 없음), (2) Cash-based profitability(Ball 2016) DART 현금흐름 의존 단독, (3) L-134 GSCD 유형 IS-only growth stability composite는 모두 OOS 소멸. EXCLUSION: (a) Quality가 overlay로 작동하는 멀티팩터 블렌드(QMJ+MOM, quality+value 등), (b) 전통 quality composite (Novy-Marx GP + Piotroski F-Score + Ohlson O-Score + Q07 등 복수 quality axis 결합)는 scope 밖 — Scout의 Quality Defensive Composite(A안)은 scope 밖. STR_1679 Q07 defense sleeve는 scope 밖.

scope.exclusion: (a) quality as overlay in multi-factor blend (QMJ+MOM, quality+value, defense sleeve within multi-sleeve portfolio); (b) traditional quality composite combining Novy-Marx GP + Piotroski F-Score + Ohlson O-Score + Q07 Earnings Stability or 3+ quality axes (this is the Scout A안 'Quality Defensive Composite' family); (c) Q07 Earnings Stability in STR_1679 defense sleeve. 회색지대 해소: L-133 CBPQ(cash-based only), L-134 GSCD(growth-stability composite IS-only overfit), L-139 Profitability Fortress(GP single-signal)의 3개 특정 construction variant만 차단; Scout A안 Novy-Marx GP + Piotroski F + Ohlson O + Q07 4축 통합 composite은 본 axiom과 구성·목적 이질적으로 scope 밖.

evidence.note: 3건 모두 Grade F/C, MDD 54~94% hard fail, standalone mode. 방향 일치.

attempts.description: STR_1655 Growth Stability Composite Diversifier standalone — IS SR 0.60 → OOS SR 0.00
STR_1657 Cash-Based Profitability Quality(Ball 2016) standalone — DART 현금흐름 데이터 품질 이슈로 시그널 역방향 작용
STR_1626 Profitability Fortress(Novy-Marx 2013) standalone — IS SR 1.044이지만 OOS retention 0.24 + recent 3Y SR 0.135 alpha decay

exception_counter.note: Quality as overlay(QMJ+MOM 등) 성공 예시는 본 scope 밖이므로 counter에 포함하지 않음. STR_1679 Q07 defense sleeve는 exclusion에 의해 scope 밖.

falsification.note: Supporting L-code 3건 = 3개 independent construction (GP/cash/composite) standalone mode에서 일관된 실패

mechanism.economic_explanation: KR quality_profitability standalone long-only의 구조적 실패 3요인: (1) Novy-Marx(2013) GP premium은 2020년대 성장주 랠리로 recent 3Y SR 급격히 약화(STR_1626 0.135). (2) Ball et al.(2016) Cash-Based Profitability는 DART 재무 현금흐름 항목의 가용성·일관성 문제로 시그널 품질 저하(STR_1657 MDD 94%). (3) Growth Stability composite는 IS overfit, OOS 완전 소멸(STR_1655 retention -0.001). 공통 원인: 한국시장에서 quality premium은 standalone long-only로 재현 불가 — value/momentum overlay 또는 멀티팩터 blending 필수 (Asness 2019 QMJ는 value와 결합 시 유효).

oos_validation.calculation_method: simple mean of OOS retention ratios: (0.24 + 0.00 + -0.001) / 3 = 0.08
oos_validation.note: STR_1626 retention 0.24, STR_1655 retention 0.00, STR_1657 retention -0.001. IS 대비 92% 열화.
